data.title: Elimination Mode Temporarily Disabled
data.summary: Read on for more details about accessing the new mode.
data.content:
Due to unforeseen technical issues, Elimination Mode has been temporarily disabled as of a server reboot on March 3 until further notice.

The developers are aware of the issues and are working hard to resolve them. We expect to have Elimination Mode back in rotation within the next week, but please stay tuned to our official social channels for further updates.

We regret the inconvenience and apologize to players looking forward to delving into Elimination. We hope you look forward to experiencing the new mode to its fullest potential in the near future!
